::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 16th 1883  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Westcountry Studies Library, Exeter/ Yonge 1883/ 1[^1]
:::

My dear [Miss Smith](people/person_263.qmd)

Thank you much  I will keep the story for the final selection.  I think the mistake is excellently done, but I am not sure that the girls’ taking the journey on purpose to defy Mr Ritchie is not too dreadful.

I am so glad you have brought out [Dulcibella](other_books/otherbook_957.qmd) again[^2]

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Envelope with violet engraving on flap addressed to Miss Carter Smith/ Thistleworth/ Stevenage and postmarked Winchester (date cut out) and Stevenage 17 January 1883.
[^2]: CMY seems to refer to two stories by Carter Smith here:  a story for the Christmas number which does not seem to have been chosen, and 'The Tramp of Many Feet', which was in course of serialization in the [*Churchman's Companion*](organizations/other_62.qmd).
